description: This file implements an unbounded goroutine executor in Go, allowing creation, tracking, and controlled shutdown of goroutines with panic recovery and logging.

classes.name: UnboundedExecutor
classes.description: A struct managing goroutine lifecycle, including starting, tracking, and stopping goroutines with panic handling.

methods.name: NewUnboundedExecutor
methods.description: Creates a new instance of UnboundedExecutor with a cancellable context.

methods.name: Go
methods.description: Starts a new goroutine, tracks its lifecycle, and recovers from panics, logging errors.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Cancels all goroutines started by this executor without waiting for them to exit.

methods.name: StopAndWaitForever
methods.description: Cancels all goroutines and waits indefinitely until all have exited.

methods.name: StopAndWait
methods.description: Cancels all goroutines and waits until they exit or the context is canceled.

methods.name: checkNoActiveGoroutines
methods.description: Checks if there are any active goroutines remaining.
